question: What was total consolidated spend in Q3, in USD?
answer:
USD 10,003,879.96 for Q3 2024.
147 rows worth 1,231,309.12 EUR are excluded: no rate on file for 2024-09 EUR.
Year assumed: 2024 - the ledger holds Q3 in both 2023 and 2024, and Q3 2023 converts completely.

notes: Period assigned by accrual_date. Nothing in the pack says which date defines a period. In THIS file accrual_date spans 2023-01-01..2024-12-31 and posting_date spans 2023-01-01..2025-01-14. They differ, and 114 row(s) fall in a different year depending on which is used.
Rows span 3 currencies (CAD, EUR, USD) and are NOT summed here. Pass them through convert_currency.

sql.statement: SELECT currency, substr(accrual_date,1,7) AS period_month, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM gl_transactions WHERE accrual_date >= ? AND accrual_date <= ? GROUP BY currency, period_month ORDER BY currency, period_month

notes: fx_rates has one rate per month per currency and no column saying whether it is spot, average or closing. Applied as a month-average rate against the transaction's accrual month.
NOT CONVERTED - no rate on file for 1 month/currency combination(s), covering 147 rows: 147 ledger rows worth 1,231,309.12 EUR in 2024-09. Any total below excludes them and is therefore partial.

sql.statement: SELECT period_month, currency, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rates
